verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ לִבְנֵי־ קֹ֑רַח עַֽל־ עֲלָמ֥וֹת שִֽׁיר׃ אֱלֹהִ֣ים לָ֭נוּ מַחֲסֶ֣ה וָעֹ֑ז נִמְצָ֥א מְאֹֽד׃ עֶזְרָ֥ה בְ֝צָר֗וֹת
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ liḇ·nê- qō·raḥ ‘al- ‘ă·lā·mō·wṯ šîr ’ĕ·lō·hîm lā·nū ma·ḥă·seh wā·‘ōz nim·ṣā mə·’ōḏ ‘ez·rāh ḇə·ṣā·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: For the choirmaster Of the sons of Korah According to Alamoth A song God is our refuge and strength an ever-present . . . help in times of trouble

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֣ן לֹא־ נִ֭ירָא אָ֑רֶץ בְּהָמִ֣יר הָ֝רִ֗ים וּבְמ֥וֹט בְּלֵ֣ב יַמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên lō- nî·rā ’ā·reṣ bə·hā·mîr hā·rîm ū·ḇə·mō·wṭ bə·lêḇ yam·mîm
verses.literal: Therefore . . . we will not fear though the earth is transformed and the mountains are toppled into the depths of the seas

verses.original: מֵימָ֑יו יֶהֱמ֣וּ יֶחְמְר֣וּ הָרִ֖ים יִֽרְעֲשֽׁוּ־ בְּגַאֲוָת֣וֹ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: mê·māw ye·hĕ·mū yeḥ·mə·rū hā·rîm yir·‘ă·šū- bə·ḡa·’ă·wā·ṯōw se·lāh
verses.literal: though their waters roar and foam and the mountains quake in the surge Selah

verses.original: נָהָ֗ר פְּלָגָ֗יו יְשַׂמְּח֥וּ עִיר־ אֱלֹהִ֑ים קְ֝דֹ֗שׁ עֶלְיֽוֹן׃ מִשְׁכְּנֵ֥י
verses.literal: There is a river whose streams delight the city of God the holy [place where] the Most High dwells

verses.original: אֱלֹהִ֣ים בְּ֭קִרְבָּהּ בַּל־ תִּמּ֑וֹט אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים יַעְזְרֶ֥הָ בֹּֽקֶר׃ לִפְנ֥וֹת
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·lō·hîm bə·qir·bāh bal- tim·mō·wṭ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ya‘·zə·re·hā bō·qer lip̄·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: God is within her she will not be moved God will help her when morning dawns

verses.original: ג֭וֹיִם הָמ֣וּ מַמְלָכ֑וֹת מָ֣טוּ אָֽרֶץ׃ תָּמ֥וּג נָתַ֥ן בְּ֝קוֹל֗וֹ
verses.transliteration: ḡō·w·yim hā·mū mam·lā·ḵō·wṯ mā·ṭū ’ā·reṣ tā·mūḡ nā·ṯan bə·qō·w·lōw
verses.literal: Nations rage kingdoms crumble the earth melts when He lifts His voice

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֣וֹת עִמָּ֑נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב מִשְׂגָּֽב־ לָ֝נוּ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ‘im·mā·nū ’ĕ·lō·hê ya·‘ă·qōḇ miś·gāḇ- lā·nū se·lāh
verses.literal: The LORD of Hosts is with us the God of Jacob is our fortress Selah

verses.original: לְֽכוּ־ חֲ֭זוּ מִפְעֲל֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־ שָׂ֖ם שַׁמּ֣וֹת בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵū- ḥă·zū mip̄·‘ă·lō·wṯ Yah·weh ’ă·šer- śām šam·mō·wṯ bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Come see the works of the LORD who brings devastation upon the earth

verses.original: מִלְחָמוֹת֮ מַשְׁבִּ֥ית עַד־ קְצֵ֪ה הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ יְ֭שַׁבֵּר קֶ֣שֶׁת וְקִצֵּ֣ץ חֲנִ֑ית יִשְׂרֹ֥ף עֲ֝גָל֗וֹת בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: mil·ḥā·mō·wṯ maš·bîṯ ‘aḏ- qə·ṣêh hā·’ā·reṣ yə·šab·bêr qe·šeṯ wə·qiṣ·ṣêṣ ḥă·nîṯ yiś·rōp̄ ‘ă·ḡā·lō·wṯ bā·’êš
verses.literal: He makes wars to cease throughout . . . the earth He breaks the bow and shatters the spear He burns the shields in the fire

verses.original: הַרְפּ֣וּ וּ֭דְעוּ כִּי־ אָנֹכִ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָר֥וּם בַּ֝גּוֹיִ֗ם אָר֥וּם בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.literal: Be still and know that I am God I will be exalted among the nations I will be exalted over the earth

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֣וֹת עִמָּ֑נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב מִשְׂגָּֽב־ לָ֝נוּ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ‘im·mā·nū ’ĕ·lō·hê ya·‘ă·qōḇ miś·gāḇ- lā·nū se·lāh
verses.literal: The LORD of Hosts is with us the God of Jacob is our fortress Selah
